front.title: Domain Name Specification for DKIM1 and DKIM2

abstract.t:
DomainKeys Identified Mail (DKIM) permits the owner of a signing domain to document that they have handled an email message by associating their domain with the message. One part of this involves publishing a public key to a Domain Name System (DNS) record associated with the domain. Signing with the associated private key establishes their connection to the message. This document describes how to find the relevant DNS record and how information is recorded within it.
This document updates RFC 6376, which describes DKIM, by clarifying the RSA public key format and by deprecating key record features that have not turned out to be useful. It also describes which parts of the key record are relevant to DomainKeys Identified Mail v2 (DKIM2) and describes a new Domain Policy Record for DKIM2 that can hold domain-wide settings.
